advisory.summary: Chưa có đủ bằng chứng cho câu hỏi này.

assumptions: Prospective known_at(T) boundary: live bookings are known through committed store membership at capture; synthetic bookings use created_at <= T in simulator time.
Prospective known_at(T) boundary: only supply/cabinet limit events announced at or before T (announced_minute <= as_of_minute) are visible to optimizer and sandbox physics.
Current backend Incident payloads carry no announcement timestamp; only incidents already effective in station state at T are included (no unannounced future benchmark incidents).
Pending HITL/resident approvals remain undecided during non-interactive sandbox rollout unless explicitly resolved in future phases.
Live runtime is never stepped, drained, or mutated during snapshot capture or sandbox rollout.
Recommendations are simulated and advisory. Ranking applies only to the finite tested set.
Feasibility is assessed against the requested goal and constraints. Use baseline evidence to assess improvement.
SLA uses original commitments unless explicitly labeled revised.
The SLA threshold applies to the full known booking cohort. Unknown outcomes prevent verification.
A site patch caps later regimes. Announced grid and cabinet limits and existing equipment caps still apply.
Above-installed candidates are conditional on hypothetical infrastructure.

result.summary: Kịch bản gốc đã đáp ứng mục tiêu đúng hạn. Có thể giữ nguyên. Phương án đầu tiên có mức công suất thấp nhất trong các mức đã xác minh khả thi. Tìm kiếm còn một phần vì có nhánh chưa thể xác minh.
